I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **November 3, 2025**.

- **Source for Nov 3:** Moss's Coastal digest from Nov 2 says "ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.
- **Nov 22:** The recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her Nov 3 is the official change and Nov 22 is when the daily work moved. I left it to her which date fits the coverage tracker.
